tagline: Check your PC. Choose a game. Manage frame generation.
independent: Independent companion for DLSSG for SM86 · Windows x64
ready_description: Files are backed up before changes. Each game is updated only when you choose to apply the verified package.
up_to_date: You already have the latest version
offline_cache: Offline: cached package verified, latest version could not be checked
update_failed: Could not obtain a verified package. Check your connection and try again.
hardware_pending: Hardware checks will start after the package check.
folder_hint: Select the game folder or paste its full path
select_exe: Choose the executable used by the game
select_game_first: Choose and analyze a game to see its checks.
hags_help: Enable Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling in Windows graphics settings, then restart your PC. A registry setting alone does not prove the change is active.
option_help: The game's integration sets the multipliers it can actually use. XeSS supports up to 4×; DLSS supports up to 6× only when the game does. Higher multipliers are not a guarantee of smoother play.
sr_help: Off keeps the game's own upscaling. L/M overrides can cost performance in Quality, Balanced or DLAA modes.
proxy_help: Start with version.dll. Try another loader only if the game does not load it. The manager keeps one active loader.
hud_never: Do not use a HUD-less image
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed
unexpected_error: An unexpected error occurred. Details were saved locally in application.log.
install_done: Installation completed. Launch the game and enable DLSS Frame Generation.
confirm_install: Apply the selected settings to this game? A backup will be kept before any files are changed.
confirm_restore: Restore the state saved before the last installation? This can return the game to a previous mod version or remove a first installation.
confirm_disable: Disable the manager's loader for this game? Your backup will be kept.
unsupported_package: This package layout is not supported by this manager version. Installation is unavailable.
prechecks_only: Preliminary checks passed. Actual frame generation still needs a test in the game.
checks_blocked: Resolve the blocked checks before installing.
verified: Frame generation verified in the recorded session
created_only: Frame generation created; waiting for its first evaluation
loaded_only: Mod loaded; frame generation has not been confirmed yet
not_verified: No verified frame generation session found
no_log: No log found yet. Launch the game, enable DLSS Frame Generation, then read the log again.
log_scope: Results refer to the latest recorded process, not a long gameplay stability test.
no_errors: No error entries in the recorded session
report_privacy: Reports stay on your PC. User and game directory paths are redacted before export.
no_managed_backup: No manager backup exists for this game. An existing manual installation can be adopted after verification.
privacy_footer: No account needed · No telemetry · Changes remain local
close_busy: An operation is running. Cancel it and wait for cleanup before closing.
launch_note: Use the game's graphics menu to enable DLSS Frame Generation. The manager will read the log while this window is open.
no_steam_games: No installed Steam games found. You can still choose a folder manually.
not_installed: The mod is not installed here
gpu_multiple: Multiple graphics adapters: confirm the game's GPU in its log
hags_runtime: Confirm GPU scheduling after restart in the game log
dx12_unverified: DirectX 12 needs confirmation in the running game
anticheat: Known anti-cheat indicators (absence is not guaranteed)
game_closed: Game is closed before file changes
mod_modified: Managed files have changed outside the manager
proxy_conflict: Unrecognized loader DLL or mod files
log_empty: The game log has no usable session
log_verified: Frame generation verified in the recorded session
log_created: Frame generation created; evaluation not yet confirmed
log_loaded: Mod loaded; frame generation not yet confirmed
log_waiting: Waiting for a frame generation session
